title: We had a Marriage Is Honorable event at the Feast of Tabernacles!
cleanTitle: We had a Marriage Is Honorable event at the Feast of Tabernacles!
segments: It's King Yashua here. I got my wife,
Yahida. We just did our West Coast Feast
of Tabernacles. We did a Marriages
Honorable event. We had a nice soulful
charcuterie board. We had a little
champagne toast. We had a bunch of
couples sit out on this beautiful patio
and dealt with some questions, some
issues, everything rooted in the
scriptures,  but also based on
kind of our experiences having years in
this truth and our years together
married as well. I think it was a very
nice event. Ambiance, everything was
fun. We did some marriage games and
things like that. Definitely something
that I think we can probably do again in
the future and I think it was well
received by everybody.
>> I think it was a great experience. We
had the chance to get up close and
personal with the couples that were with
us today. And like, you're just there
rooted in the scriptures and were able
to share our own personal struggles and
how we were able to overcome those
throughout the years.
>> Definitely something worthwhile. Maybe
something to emulate and do again
elsewhere. Definitely had a great time
doing it.
